name: restaurant-management-system
description: Restaurant POS API and cashier desktop app. Web frontends live in restaurant-pos-website and restaurant-pos-operations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,QUEUE,REVERB,POS "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:reverb" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:queue: cd apps/api && php artisan queue:work redis --queue=default --sleep=1 --tries=3 --timeout=60
